claims.claim: You can apply or do this online.
claims.quote: You can fill in a form or apply online.
claims.note: The England guidance explicitly permits online applications.

claims.claim: You can apply or do this by phone.
claims.quote: Your local council might also let you apply by telephone.
claims.note: Phone applications depend on the local council and are not a universal route.

claims.claim: The applicant must be liable for Council Tax at the address.
claims.quote: be the person named on the Council Tax bill – this means you’re liable to pay Council Tax
claims.note: The Scotland guidance states this requirement, but the supplied text does not establish it across every council scheme.

claims.claim: Proof of income and savings is required.
claims.quote: For example, you might have to send evidence of your income and savings.
claims.note: Evidence of income and savings may be requested, but it is not stated as a universal requirement.

claims.claim: A Council Tax bill is required as application evidence.
claims.note: The sources discuss a Council Tax bill but do not say an applicant must provide the bill as evidence.
